meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of what the public home and practice pages of law-firm websites showed when they were read; each count covers those pages, and a website is placed in the state of the first office address it lists.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

summary: What US law-firm websites offer, from 123,823 law-firm websites read (out of 1,101,164 websites visited, 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30): the share that show Spanish-language pages, an online booking tool, live chat, LegalService or Attorney structured data, review markup, HTTPS and a 24/7 intake statement, for every state with at least 100 websites and every practice area with at least 100, plus the number of websites with Spanish pages for each 100,000 Spanish-speaking residents with limited English. No firm is named.
